headword: {昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}
reading: こんちゅうさいしゅう

definitions.explanation: The activity of catching and preserving insects, traditionally a popular summer hobby for Japanese children, often as a school break project.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went bug collecting over summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧だ。
examples.english: My older brother's hobby is insect collecting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}{研究|けんきゅう}→自由研究：28022_jiyuukenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: My son decided to make insect collecting the theme of his summer research project.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{昆虫|こんちゅう}→昆虫：05010_konchuu⟧ (insect) + ⟦{採集|さいしゅう}→採集：00355_saishuu⟧ (gathering, collecting). A classic summer-vacation activity in Japan, often combined with a ⟦{自由|じゆう}{研究|けんきゅう}→自由研究：28022_jiyuukenkyuu⟧ (independent research) school assignment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go bug collecting
- {昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: insect-collecting kit (net, case, etc.)
- ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{昆虫採集|こんちゅうさいしゅう}: summer-vacation insect collecting

CULTURAL NOTE:
The stereotypical kit includes a {虫取|むしと}り⟦{網|あみ}→網：22587_ami⟧ (insect net) and a {虫|むし}かご (insect cage). Popular target insects include {蝉|せみ} (cicadas), ⟦{蝶|ちょう}→蝶：04288_chou⟧ (butterflies), and ⟦カブトムシ→カブトムシ：05199_kabutomushi⟧ (rhinoceros beetles).
